title: frangula dodonei
intro: Frangula dodonei, commonly known as Greek buckthorn, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rhamnaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, which include treating digestive issues, such as constipation and diarrhea, as well as reducing inflammation and improving liver function. The therapeutic actions of Frangula dodonei are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, increase bowel movements, and act as a purgative. The bioactive constituents of the plant include anthraquinones, which are responsible for its laxative properties and other medicinal effects.
